integrity: Two reproducible, exhaustive, standard-library verification programs enumerate all faces, verify the finite discrete Morse certificate and exact integral boundary, and compute the complete representation character. External independent validation is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Classification is restricted to the ordinary Morse complex of K_{3,4} and its rational S_3 times S_4 homology representation, without any equivariant homotopy assertion or infinite-parameter extension.
title: The Morse complex of \(K_{3,4}\): a 432-sphere wedge and its full bipartition-symmetry character
